# Simone Slawitz — Official Website

Official website: https://simoneslawitz.com/
Name: Simone Slawitz
Brand line: (Beyond) The Race
Role: Italian editorial photographer and videomaker.
Location: Italy. Available for selected editorial and commissioned work across Italy and Europe.

## Professional positioning

Simone Slawitz is an Italian editorial photographer specialising in motorsport heritage, historic cars, automotive events, luxury reportage, discreet visual storytelling and editorial videomaking.

Core fields:
- Motorsport heritage photography
- Historic and classic car photography
- Automotive event reportage
- Editorial photography for motorsport, heritage and luxury contexts
- Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este photography
- Mille Miglia photography
- Monaco Historique photography
- WEC Imola photography
- Minardi Day photography
- Luxury objects and watches editorial photography
- Editorial videomaking for motorsport, automotive, luxury and event projects

## Awards and recognition

- Bruno Boni Photography Competition winner, 2023.
- Best Black and White Award, 2025.
- Exhibition: Cavallerizza Art Gallery, Brescia, Italy.
